item.title: By: Mathias
item.dc:creator: Mathias
item.description: I would have liked to see your presentation. A question relating to cooporate webblogging: have you got any thoughts on the issues regarding confidential information? I run an internal blog in my company but also an external blog – it’s essentially the same information, but with the internal blog allowing for confidential information. This doesn’t seem like the optimal setup though. Any experience in this dilemma?
